messages.author: 89c019bed9c42268
messages.subject: configuration for package 'rcdd' failed
parts:
To whom it may concern,

I've begun to use Shiny and it seems great. I have a Shiny App that I would like to upload; however, it seems to fail whenever 'rcdd' is installed. It is a dependency of one of the packages I need. I've tied to install this in the way I would expect loading the necessary libraries in ui.R and I've also just tried to load 'rcdd'. All the packages install properly locally, and runApp() runs the app perfectly on this computer. I always get this error: 

[2015-07-09T18:13:14.618104533+0000] Building R package: rcdd (1.1-9)
/mnt/packages/build /mnt
* installing to library ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library’
* installing *source* package ‘rcdd’ ...
** package ‘rcdd’ successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked
checking for gcc... gcc -std=gnu99
checking whether the C compiler works... yes
checking for C compiler default output file name... a.out
checking for suffix of executables... 
checking whether we are cross compiling... no
checking for suffix of object files... o
checking whether we are using the GNU C compiler... yes
checking whether gcc -std=gnu99 accepts -g... yes
checking for gcc -std=gnu99 option to accept ISO C89... none needed
checking for __gmpz_init in -lgmp... no
configure: error: GNU MP not found, see README
ERROR: configuration failed for package ‘rcdd’
* removing ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/rcdd’
################################# End Task Log ################################# 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 52818064 failed: Error building image: Error building rcdd (1.1-9). Build exited with non-zero status: 1

I would greatly appreciate any advice on how to circumvent this error.

Thanks,

Daniel

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: configuration for package 'rcdd' failed
parts:
Daniel,

It looks like the rcdd package needs some setup on shinyapps.io to work correctly (specifically it looks like we need to install the GNU MB big num library). I will work on getting this working, and will send you a note when its resolved. It will probably be sometime tomorrow afternoon.

Sorry for the inconvenience,
Andy

messages.author: 16b615d134a4f7a0
messages.subject: Re: configuration for package 'rcdd' failed
parts:
You should install libgmp3-dev in Linux

sudo apt-get install libgmp3-dev

Worked for me.
